name: Eversource Massachusetts Discount Program (discount rate)
description: Discount on Eversource electric or gas bills for customers who receive a qualifying public assistance benefit or meet household income requirements. Discounts as of Nov. 1, 2026 range from 22% to 92% depending on income, household size and heating type.
contact: Call 211 or visit https://www.masscap.org/agencies/ to find your local Community Action Agency (income-based applications)

requirements.text: Must be an Eversource electric or gas customer. (Eversource is listed as the electric company for Amherst by UMass Amherst.)

Qualify by receiving a public assistance benefit (e.g. HEAP/Fuel Assistance, SNAP, MassHealth Basic or Standard, TAFDC, EAEDC, WIC, Head Start, public or subsidized housing, SSP, Veterans' Chapter 115 benefits) OR by meeting household income requirements.

Annual household income for all adults 18+ (combined gross income of all persons in the household) must be at or below 60% of State Median Income. Benefit recipients may qualify without meeting this test. Households receiving a qualifying public benefit can also qualify; see the provider page.
